items.title: Leon Rene Interview, 1979-05-07
items.q: My uncle said, you think you're going to be like Irving Berlin? ... I said, maybe so. I don't say I'll be as great as Irving Berlin, but I said, I might use him as my... As a goal

ctx.x: Well, now, did you study music in college?

No, I studied music aside. Just like I said, as I was getting experience with the band, I began to study music in Harlem. Well, you went to three colleges. No, I went to... I went to Welfelforce University. I went to Southern University of Welfelforce University. I didn't finish college. You didn't go to... That's why my dad said, if you don't finish college, you're going to have to lay bricks. That's why I had to go to lay bricks. He said, you stop. He said, you quit college? He said, you start laying bricks. So…
Well, I saw in one of the books that you went to Xavier.
